means: One line of the explored catalog: a source looked at for a concern, with date, kept blob, its location, unread ranges and breadcrumbs.
The smallest excerpt or own-words summary of a source that answers the concern; noise (nav, ads, boilerplate, changelogs) filtered out. Not the skill blob (C10).
A part of a source the pass did not read (sections, line or character ranges, linked pages), recorded so a later run can resume there.
A deferred pointer to a resource seen or inferred but not followed, tied to its source blob, with a confidence and the reason it waits.
How a claim is known: concrete (read and checked), gist (seen in a summary), inferred (from memory or context; confirming search deferred).
The order concerns are explored in a coarse run: function and features, then security, then nomenclature and its meaning for the product. Lower ranks wait.
A survey pass with a source budget per concern (default 5): search first, the one best source, smallest blob kept, the rest left as breadcrumbs.

name: explored catalog
claim: A catalog of explored records (where looked, when, kept blob, its location, unread ranges) lets a later run reuse covered ground and resume at unread ranges instead of refetching; the outside-source counterpart of collector (vifitn) (docs/platform/survey-A3-A5.md).

name: deferred breadcrumbs
claim: Resources seen or inferred but not followed are kept as breadcrumbs attributed to their blob with a confidence (concrete, gist, inferred), so deferring costs one line and the place of each lead is known (docs/platform/survey-A3-A5.md).

name: ranked coarse run
claim: A run that ranks concerns (function and features, security, nomenclature and meaning), spends a fixed source budget in rank order and defers the rest keeps token use bounded without losing leads (docs/platform/survey-A3-A5.md).
